_comment: Every dynamic-code and raw-HTML sink that ships to a browser, named and justified.
An entry is a promise about a specific file: the sink is there, someone looked at it,
and here is why it is allowed to stay. sast-dynamic-code-sinks fails on a sink that is
not listed AND on a listed entry whose file no longer contains that sink, because an
allowlist nobody prunes is how a check quietly stops checking. Line numbers are
evidence, not part of the match — they are allowed to drift.

entries.reason: The only eval-class sink in the product. It executes the `formula` string from data/calculators/**.json, which scripts/generate-content.ts writes with the Anthropic SDK. It is also the reason next.config.ts must keep script-src 'unsafe-eval' sitewide, so a SECOND entry here is not free — it entrenches that directive. tests/calculators.test.ts pins the formulas for determinism; the identifiers they may name are not pinned anywhere.
IN_APP_BOOT_SCRIPT, a compile-time constant from lib/in-app.ts. No interpolation, no runtime input.
ICON_PATHS[name] is a static literal from that same file, and the only interpolated value, `title`, goes through escapeXml. tests/xss-protection.test.ts:113 pins both halves verbatim.
JSON-LD built from repo-controlled content, with `<` replaced before it is written so the payload cannot close the <script>. tests/xss-protection.test.ts:56 pins the replace.
